quests.title: A Ledger Without Ink
quests.objective: Recover the lost satchel on the Old Watch Trail, gather 3 Ironbark Heartwood, and bring both to the fort.

quests.title: A Furnace That Remembers
quests.objective: Collect 4 Basalt Iron and 2 Froststeel Ore; use the cold stock to repair a cooling regulator, then carry the restored regulator to the foundry.

quests.title: The Last Warm Mile
quests.objective: Recover a stranded supply sled, gather 3 Cinderwood in the Ashen Wastes, then escort the sled through one ambush encounter.

quests.title: What the Brood Left Behind
quests.objective: Gather 3 shed Drake Sinew at abandoned nesting ledges and recover a stolen field journal without harming healthy drakes.

quests.title: Water Beneath the Road
quests.objective: Bring 3 Tidebronze and 3 Oiled Reed Cord from two regions, repair a buried well, and deliver water to the stranded caravan.

quests.title: A Cure in Three Parcels
quests.objective: Gather 3 Bogroot Fiber, 2 Rimepine resin samples and 2 saltwater culture samples; protect the healer while the antidote is prepared.

quests.title: Names Under the Mud
quests.objective: Recover three named grave tablets and carry rubbings to Deadwind Hollow for comparison; return the matched names to their families.

quests.title: The Thread That Leads Home
quests.objective: Follow a missing courier’s thread trail, defeat the creature holding the courier, and recover 3 Webglass with the abandoned route markers.

quests.title: Orders for the Living
quests.objective: Recover a captured dispatch case, obtain 4 Blackthorn Iron and 3 Tempered Plainsteel, and deliver repaired field braces to an isolated unit.

quests.title: Salvage Rights
quests.objective: Recover a ship’s bell from a wreck, gather 4 Saltbound Oak, and arbitrate a salvage dispute before delivering the repaired bell.

quests.title: Cargo Too Hot to Carry
quests.objective: Collect 3 Drakeglass and 3 Froststeel Ore to build an insulated carrier, then escort a rescued egg to its rookery.

quests.title: A Voice Through the Storm
quests.objective: Gather 3 Thundersteel and 2 Singing Quartz, restore two relay posts, and carry their calibration record back through the pass.

quests.title: The Missing Constellation
quests.objective: Recover three lens fragments from separate landmarks and obtain 3 Veil Silver for their mounts; return the repaired observation plate.

quests.title: Return to Sender, Explosively
quests.objective: Recover a misrouted pressure chest, gather 4 Springbrass and 2 Tidebronze, and test a replacement safety valve in a controlled encounter.

quests.title: Music for a Silent Crossing
quests.objective: Gather 4 Singing Quartz and 2 Storm Cedar, restore a wind beacon, then guide a lost caravan using its recovered melody.

quests.title: The Bell With No Name
quests.objective: Retrieve a bell clapper, obtain the grave rubbings recovered in the Mire, and deliver the reunited records after a spirit encounter.

quests.title: The Keeper’s Unfinished Parcel
quests.objective: Collect 3 Mist Silk, 3 Moon Yew and a courier seal from an abandoned aqueduct; restore an old case containing directions to the relic outside the city.

quests.title: Letters From the Edge
quests.objective: Rescue a survey team, recover three field reports, and obtain 3 Null Obsidian before carrying the reports to a safe mainland archive.

quests.title: The Last Ember of the Old Craft
quests.objective: Recover the aqueduct’s focusing ring; deliver 6 Veil Silver, 4 Thundersteel and 4 Springbrass; restore the channels and defeat the relic guardian.
quests.reward: Mistvale relic forge unlocked; apparent finale, celebration and complete journal entry. No secret-forge silhouette or percentage-complete hint.

quests.title: A Map Beneath the Ink
quests.objective: Automatic once-only scene: blue energy touches the ledger, old marks align, and a previously blank spread becomes a map into the sands.
quests.reward: Unlock the hidden chapter and offer its three investigations simultaneously.

quests.title: Where Dawn Was Buried
quests.objective: Follow three shifting landmarks to the Dawnwell Ruins, solve their shadow alignment and recover a solar lens; carry it to the buried threshold.

quests.title: A Weight the World Forgot
quests.objective: Gather 6 Springbrass, 4 Scaleiron and 4 Thundersteel across three territories, recover a pressure diagram, and deliver the completed regulator to the buried threshold.

quests.title: The Metal Remembers
quests.objective: Obtain a Relic Memory Core and 4 Sunbronze, use Mistvale to imprint a calibration token without consuming an equipped weapon, and carry it to the buried threshold.
quests.reward: Memory seal installed; the core is consumed in the quest token.

quests.title: The Forge Beneath All Names
quests.objective: Open the buried chamber, survive its guardian encounter and align all three restored mechanisms.
quests.reward: Greatest forge unlocked: up to 200% perfect attack, smooth silver/gold finish and yellow static; original core element remains.

global_rules.optional: Never gates main campaign liberation, travel or hero recruitment.
global_rules.order: After the opening commission, regional commissions can be accepted and completed in any accessible order except the linked Mire/Hollow record task and Mistvale milestones.
global_rules.pages: One regional reward is a folio containing several leaves, not a single tiny page. All 18 folios have explicit rewards; 8 are sufficient to approach Mistvale. The player can keep collecting the others afterward.
global_rules.book: Granted on first mission acceptance, before its completion. Recipe names and hidden numbers appear only when earned. Discovery never creates an item or unlocks an unknown source automatically.
global_rules.delivery: Gathered objectives accept previously collected ordinary stock. Named quest objects are bound, non-sellable and cannot be irreversibly lost. Rare core objectives explicitly warn of consumption.
global_rules.clocks: No expiration, real-time countdown, daily rotation, or forced grinding to retain progress.
global_rules.curse: Both Mire and Hollow remain unliberated until their shared main-story climax; courier record recovery does not cleanse either map.
global_rules.spoilers: Sands investigations are absent from player quest menus, completion counts, map pins and NPC hints until book_awakening.
global_rules.access: No mission requires recruiting a specific hero. Resident hero and guild contacts remain available on either branch.
global_rules.recovery: If a required battle is lost, objectives remain retryable; consumed turn-in goods commit with rewards atomically.
